sections.value: Your petitioner prays for the following reliefs;

value:
Use this information to enhance the draft:
The role is 'Petitioner & Respondent'.

The relief's sought can be so many. Hence it should begin with, 'AN ORDER..', 'A DECLARATION' etc.

The common grounds for an election petition includes: 'The return of the respondent as the winner of the election of the __ held on __, was invalid, by corrupt practices and non-compliance, with the provisions of the Electoral Act, 20..', 'That the respondent was not duly elected by a majority of lawful votes cast.', 'That the person whoose election is questioned was, at the tim of the election, not qualified to contest the election.' etc.

The common reliefs for an election petition includes: 'A declaration that the respondent was not duly elected.', 'A declaration that the election and the return of the respondent is void, the election having been marred by substantial irregularities.', ' An order that a fresh election be conducted by the respondent.' etc.

There are few tribunals or court that can handle election petitions, they include, 'IN THE COURT OF APPEAL for the office of the president', 'IN THE GOVERNORSHIP ELECTION TRIBUNAL OF __ STATE for governorship election', 'IN THE NATIONAL AND STATE HOUSES OF ASSEMBLY ELECTION TRIBUNAL for election in the senate'.

 
Usually Petitioners are; The candidate(s) and the political party. so it should be like '1st petitioner' & '2nd petitioner', likewise respondents.

Independent national electoral commission (INEC) is usually the last respondent in any election petion, unless the petition is challenging a primary election in a political party.

For petition in a primary election, the appropriate court with jurisdiction, is the FEDERAL HIGH COURT.

The draft should be within 500-10000 words.

Use today's date, to fill the date section.
